Property Information
Information Disclaimer
This information is provided to the public "as is" without warranty of any kind, expressed or implied. Assessed values are subject to change by the assessor, Board of Review, or State Equalization processes. Additionally, statutory exemptions may affect the taxable values. In no event will the assessor be liable to anyone for damages arising from the use of the property data. You assume responsibility for the selection of data to achieve your intended results, and for the installation and use of the results obtained from the property data.
If preparing a legal document, please contact the Recorder's Office at 701-577-4540 or complete the online contact form for how to obtain the full legal description.
Property Cards
A property card is provided for every real estate parcel and building in Williams County. Property cards provide information about the property valuation, building permits, acreage, and any structures on the property. Each result also has a generalized sketch of the property. Searches can be performed by real estate (parcel number or address) or by building.
Search Property Cards
Property Tax Information
Use Williams County's iTax system to search for current and historical parcel/property valuations and property taxes, pay your property taxes online, and download a copy of your most recent property tax bill. For more information about how to pay your property taxes, visit the Payments page .
Search Property Tax Information
Parcel Information
The Williams County Address and Parcel Explorer (formerly two maps: Parcel Viewer and Master Address Viewer) allows users to search for parcel information by parcel number, owner name, or address. The map provides information such as parcel number, parcel address, owner names, owner mailing address, and a link to tax information.
Access the Address and Parcel Explorer
Legal Descriptions
Please contact the Recorder's Office for information about how to obtain the full legal description for a parcel.
